_doc: M7-04 — the strings the Home screen (S03) shows, and nothing else. It exists because X-04 requires every user-facing string to be a loc key in EN and DE from day one, and because ContentInvariants.CheckLocaleKeyReferences fails a loc key that nothing in the content set names — a key referenced only from C# is an orphan, and an orphan is fatal. This document is that naming. Deliberately narrow, and the narrowness is the design: Home shows the two Energy amounts the player snapshot literally carries and no denominator, no regeneration countdown, no Legend-XP percentage and no run Energy cost, because every tuning reader that could compute one is internal to Core and IGameHost exposes no derived-value read — a label authored here would invite a second copy of a formula Core already owns. The `status.runLapsed` line is the one place the two-day run window is admitted to the player (`16` D70): a run left untouched past `tuning/progression.json#/runLifetime/expiryHours` is refused by every run command, and Home offers a NEW run because START_RUN is the one command that settles the lapsed one. Without this line the screen simply shows a different button, which reads as lost progress rather than as an authored window. It names no number — the window is tuning, and a sentence that transcribed it would be a second copy of it. The hero diorama, daily quests, ad widgets, chest pity, event and guild cards, the inbox envelope, the account-link banner, the bottom navigation and the Dungeons entry are later milestones' and author no strings here.
